svg.aria-label: Two top-down views of a prim, with +Y toward you, the parent's x to the right and -z up. In the order written above, translate then rotateY (T · R), the prim turns 30 degrees about its own centre while that centre is at the origin, then moves to (1, 0.5, 0). Reversed (R · T), it moves to (1, 0.5, 0) first, then swings 30 degrees about the parent's Y axis, on a circle of radius 1 around the parent's origin, to (0.87, 0.5, -0.5). It ends turned the same way in both.
